items.title: Eddie Marrero Interview, 1979-12-04
items.q: Old Forsy. Now he told a. Big lie too. I read a piece in that book. About Old Forsy. Say he was the manager.

ctx.x: 20. 21. Nearly 22. Man. So. The same bunch. Trahi. Loicontra. Paul. Born. Old Forsy. Now he told a. Big lie too. I read a piece in that book. About Old Forsy. Say he was the manager. He had to go on the move man. We pick up oil.
